definition.name: Retail Display · internal candidate v1
definition.description: UNAPPROVED CANDIDATE · INTERNAL EVIDENCE PILOT. Human evidence capture only; not an official GTI standard. No conditional rules, skip, external dispatch, procurement, automatic tasks or archive. After all stages, project closure still requires a separately Director-approved per-project document policy, actual Owner completion request and separate Director final decision. Blueprint gti-retail-display revision 1; source 2026-09-29 SHA-256 4d86f90d173a406ad9f3a5ffbba7ce55776b5d209f4bc2a0e4653f299d61b944. Seven configurable evidence stages. No relational production units or outlet engine, sample-coverage calculation, engineering certification, physical-prototype validation or all-outlets-or-issue-tasks completion gate. Internal candidate choice: requiredness, bounds, file counts, reviewer routing and fixed gates need business confirmation.

stages.title: Brief
stages.description: Capture display scope, available space and supplied restrictions. Enter agreed units; no safety or regulatory threshold is inferred. What now: record applicable information, attach evidence and obtain independent review. Move on: complete all configured fixed gates. Internal candidate choice: requiredness, bounds, file counts, reviewer routing and fixed gates need business confirmation.

workflow.interpretation: Source sequence retained as configurable evidence stages. Creative work uses existing Universal Tasks; no legacy concept engine. Internal candidate choice: requiredness, bounds, file counts, reviewer routing and fixed gates need business confirmation.

gaps.missing: Detailed requiredness, review routing, file limits, checklists and stage completion criteria absent from the source need confirmation; no official designation process.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Required fields, counts and gates are labeled candidate decisions. No measurement unit or engineering/compliance threshold is invented.

gaps.missing: No per-outlet survey coverage calculation or conditional Owner-approved representative-sample decision.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Survey-basis choice, attached outlet register and fixed independent Owner evidence review for both choices. This does not verify coverage or sample eligibility.

gaps.missing: No relational production units, per-component dimensions/files/checklists, quantity completeness or component lifecycle.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Named component summary, editable scalar fields, attached register and human checklist. Structure/header/side panels/shelf talkers/shutters/lighting are not separate runtime entities.

gaps.missing: No per-outlet installed/accepted state tracking or every-outlet-accepted OR open-issues-assigned-to-tasks gate; no task-to-outlet adapter.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Record a register with source statuses and issue references. Manually create actual General Tasks; a reference or checklist cannot verify their assignment or satisfy the missing source gate.

gaps.missing: No automatic concept-task completion, count or stage dependency gate; source supplies no specific concept approver or definition of done.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Manually create Initial/Final Concept tasks. Independent uploaded render/planogram review is a proposed internal evidence gate only.

gaps.missing: No engineering certification, load/weight/safety calculation or validation of retailer, electrical or market compliance.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Store supplied dimensions with explicitly entered units, drawings and human inspection notes. No certification or compliance threshold implied.

gaps.missing: No verified physical prototype lifecycle, assembly-test validation or series-production quality certification.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Mandatory internal evidence upload and attestation record a human review only; a PDF/photo cannot prove the physical prototype is valid.

gaps.missing: No vendor/CERBER procurement, full stakeholder approval chain or approved external series-production order dispatch.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Director approves internal production evidence. No external order, vendor communication or financial action.

gaps.missing: No automatic per-component large-format artwork validation, material-specific resolution, scale or naming preflight.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Exact-version uploads and human File Standard review, retaining source base and display variant requirements without certifying binary contents.

gaps.missing: No prefilled documents, before-artwork signed-contract guard, per-outlet bilateral Acceptance Protocol or external signature lifecycle; legal wording remains open.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Upload manually prepared brief/RFP/contract/protocol evidence by purpose. Final completion-document policy remains a separate explicit Director decision.

gaps.missing: No installation scheduling engine, budget accounting, warranty/service lifecycle or automatic starter/issue tasks.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Record dates, currency, schedule/register and service contacts. Use existing General Tasks manually; no automatic assignment or reminders.

gaps.missing: Source stage acceptance and automatic closure/archive cannot replace explicit V2 project completion governance.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Fixed stage gates do not certify all outlets. Final completion still requires Director-approved per-project document policy, actual Owner request and separate Director decision; no auto-archive.

tasker.instructions: Manually create Initial Concept tasks for 3D directions and planogram layouts. No source-prescribed mandatory concept count or approver is inferred.
Use Final Concept tasks for development where appropriate, selecting eligible exact inspiration. Reviewed upload evidence does not prove all concept tasks completed.

blueprint.revisionPolicy: Increment blueprint revision for content or policy changes. Keep semantic IDs for unchanged meanings; new meanings need new IDs and a compatibility map. Imported copies are editable and edits are not automatically source-certified. Published versions and runtime pins never change.
